https://storage.googleapis.com/magentadata/js/checkpoints/music_rnn/chord_pitches_improv/
Upstream runtime and checkpoint files are bundled unmodified. Studio supplies seeded sampling, score conversion, arrangement and worker integration separately.
This general pretrained model has not been trained specifically for Pokémon by this app. No Pokémon songs or ROMs are bundled with the model.
TensorFlow.js WebAssembly backend 2.8.6 is bundled under Apache-2.0.
The MusicRNN browser bundle also includes Tonal (MIT) and protobuf.js (BSD-3-Clause); their licences are included here.
